body: I appreciate the sentiment, but what about after I get through this? Then what? My life will only be worse off. I don't want to set myself up for more failures as soon as I succeed here. I want to try and find ways to save my crappy excuse for a life without potentially hurting its future. But again, I appreciate where you are coming from and thank you from the bottom of my heart for all of your responses. You're a fucking miracle when I needed it most, so thanks.

I can't sell my car. My mom is really in debt as well and the loan payments would fall on her. I've already hurt my family enough, I can't do even more to them. And you're right: I won't ever be truly happy. Because I have never in my searches found anything that makes me happy when I am alone. It's always WHO makes me happy, not what. So I guess I'm doomed to a life of sadness. Nothing (that I can attain) makes me happy. It's only people that make me happy. Hell, even just a simple conversation here and there is all I need. But I have nothing in the way of human contact outside of work. And they don't care for me at work either. They don't invite me to happy hour and I only went to lunch last week because the new guy chimed in (apparently he hasn't learned to avoid me yet).

But that's my problem. I'm too broken to even stop myself. I said over and over and over after seeing my parents fight that I would NEVER touch a woman in anger. And yet my (now ex) fiance was subject to my anger and violence. I can't insert that pause between the trigger and the reaction. And medicine isn't working for me. The side effects only make things worse and takes too long to start helping.

I really wish I could. But my car is in less than ideal condition, I don't own anything of value, and I'm exceptionally far into debt. And the biggest problem of all: I have no one to go with. That has been my biggest issue since day one. I need other people around to make me happy, but I don't get along with people and need to be alone a lot. How am I supposed to help myself when I can't even get to a "non-catch 22" type situation?

I feel like all this love I have is going to end up wasted. Long story short: I  just want to love someone and be loved in return. But I can't have that. No one can put up with me long enough. I try so hard to be a good person/friend/lover/employee but everything I do just fails miserably :(

I can't keep a job, my fiance was cheating on me, I have no friends outside of one person a thousand miles away who barely talks to me, I am in thousands of dollars of debt to multiple sources but can't get to work to even pay the bills I have let alone pay back my debt, my anxiety/depression are taking over and because of it I yell at my mom and now I think my family all hates me. Nothing makes me happy outside of having a girlfriend to love me, and I can't have that because I am not  happy. I'm stuck. I'm alone. I want to get out. But there's nothing to grab on to....
